title: RepoLaunch: Automating Build and Management of Code Repositories across Languages and Platforms
abstract: arXiv:2603.05026v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Language model (LM) agents have driven substantial progress in automated software engineering (SWE), yet building and testing software repositories at scale remains a largely manual and labor-intensive bottleneck. In this work, we introduce RepoLaunch, a novel agentic framework that automatically resolves dependencies, compiles source code, and extracts test results across diverse programming languages and operating systems. RepoLaunch achieves a 78% build success rate, outperforming the Python/Linux-only prior system by 18%. To demonstrate its application, we further present a fully automated pipeline for SWE dataset creation driven by RepoLaunch, which only requires human input at the task-design stage. RepoLaunch is open-sourced, and its automated task-generation pipeline has been adopted by several recent works on agentic benchmarking and training.

translated_title: RepoLaunch：跨语言与平台的代码仓库构建与管理自动化
translated_abstract: 语言模型（LM）智能体推动了自动化软件工程（SWE）领域的重大进展，然而大规模构建和测试软件仓库在很大程度上仍然是一个依赖手工、劳动密集型的瓶颈。在这项工作中，我们提出了RepoLaunch，一个新颖的智能体框架，能够在多种编程语言和操作系统上自动解决依赖关系、编译源代码并提取测试结果。RepoLaunch实现了78%的构建成功率，比仅支持Python/Linux的先前系统高出18%。为了展示其应用，我们进一步提出了一个由RepoLaunch驱动的用于SWE数据集创建的全自动流水线，该流水线仅在任务设计阶段需要人工输入。RepoLaunch已开源，其自动化任务生成流水线已被近期多项关于智能体基准测试和训练的工作所采用。
tldr: RepoLaunch是一个跨多种编程语言和操作系统的智能体框架，能够自动解决依赖、编译源代码并提取测试结果，构建成功率达78%（超越仅支持Python/Linux的先前系统18%），并支撑了仅需任务设计阶段人工输入的全自动SWE数据集创建流水线。
en_tdlr: RepoLaunch is an agentic framework that automatically resolves dependencies, compiles source code, and extracts test results across diverse languages and operating systems, achieving a 78% build success rate (18% higher than prior Python/Linux-only systems) and powering a fully automated SWE dataset creation pipeline requiring human input only at the task-design stage.
